title: Prefix sums
learn: prefix[i] = sum up to i, range sum in O(1), prefix + hash map for subarray-sum problems, prefix/suffix products
hook: "How many subarrays sum to k?" is a favourite follow-up because the obvious sliding window fails on negative numbers. Prefix sums plus a hash map solve it in one pass.

explain.prompt: Explain prefix sums, and how you'd count the subarrays that sum to k when the array can contain negative numbers.
keyPoints: prefix[i] = sum of the first i numbers, so sum(l..r) = prefix[r + 1] − prefix[l] in O(1)
a subarray ending at i sums to k when some earlier prefix equals s − k
keep a hash map of how often each prefix sum appeared, seeded with {0: 1}
O(n) time and space; a sliding window doesn't work because negatives break monotonic sums
